page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with headword entries; page number at top left, running head "PO." at top centre. No margin notes. Catchword "Poëta ]" set at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: Ascon. Minister Falerni, Catul. Servus à lagena, Fulv. Vrsin. Suppromus, Plaut.
Poculum ] Calix. Scyphus, Cic. Toreuma. Plin.

Poculum magnum ] Poculum immane, Heracleum, Cic. Anancæum, Plaut. Modiales Phialæ, calices. Puteus argenteus. Propino tibi decumâ fonte. Argenteus puteus, Plaut. Athenæ. Amystis Threjicia, Hor. Crater Philotesius, Er.
Podagricus ] Podager, Claud. Podagrosus, Plin. Articularius, Plaut.
Poëma ] Carmen, Cic. Poësis, Her. Pictura tacita. Vorsa facundia, Apul. Epigramma, Mart.

Pœna ] Punitio, Cic. Disciplina, Quint. Supplicium. Multatio bonorum. Castigatio, Cic. Dedere aliquem noxæ. Liv. Censura, Juv. Censio, Piaculum, Liv. Vindicta legis, Ovid. Luela sceleris, Lucr. Malum, Plaut.
Pœna sit in exemplum ] Pœna unius multorum sit metus.
Pœnam quæris? ] Prurit tibi dorsum? Plaut.
Pœna venit, sera licet ] Quæ peccamus juvenes, luimus senes. Lento gradu ad vindictam sui divina procedit ira, sed tarditatem, gravitate supplicii compensat. Val. Max.

Pœnas dare ] Persolvere pœnas sceleris. Pœnas sceleris à se repetere. Pendere pœnas, Perferre, sustinere. Dependere pœnas exitiô. Multari morte, bonis, Cic. Piacularem fieri ob stultitiam alicujus, Plaut. Transfigere aliquod scelus pœnâ, Quint. Dedi pœnarum satis, Hor. Exsolvere pœnas. Ter. Pœnam luere, Tac. Peccatum luere, Liv.

Pœnitet ] Piget facti. Suppœnitet me hujus rei. Acerbè fero, Cic. Indoluit facto, Ovid. Pœnitentia cœpti me tenet, Sen. Nihil me pœnitet, Cic. Habet me miserum animi petulantia mea. Dolet hoc cordi meo, Plaut, Pœnitentiam ago sermonis mei, Tac. Resìdere pœnitentiam, Plin. l. 34. c. 14. v. Resipiscere.
Poësis ] Poetica, Cic. Poetice, Non. Versificatio, Quint. Ars musica. Studium musicum, Ter.

page.notes: Catchword "Poëta ]" is at the foot right; it is also printed at the end of the last paragraph and is given once here as the catchword. Some words in the running text are faint or marked with ink spots; a few letters in "Ascon." and "Vorsa" are uncertain.
